Over on Somerset there was less emphasis for making excuses for racism. A back and forth on the wall with vague threats and persistent silencing of Black artists took place over a number of days. Police would monitor and stop Black and PoC people who were trying to save the wall.

The commercial gallery scene is white-dominated and the graffiti and street art scenes are gatekeeping Black artists Profoundly talented Black artists and disproportionately tagged over vs white peers of similar or lesser level of skill.
